title: LLM-as-a-Supervisor: Mistaken Therapeutic Behaviors Trigger Targeted Supervisory Feedback

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by measuring the model's accuracy and recall in classifying 'Cultural Insensitivity' and 'Ignoring Cultural Background and Diversity' as therapeutic mistakes within simulated therapist-client dialogues.
Evaluated by assessing the model's capability to correctly identify 'Gender Stereotyping' as a specific category of mistaken therapeutic behavior in counseling interactions.

Measured as a component of evaluating the model's performance in detecting the 'Ignore Cultural Background and Diversity' therapeutic mistake, which encompasses overlooking a client's sexual orientation.

Measured as a component of evaluating the model's performance in detecting the 'Ignore Cultural Background and Diversity' therapeutic mistake, which encompasses overlooking the impact of religious factors.
